sources.title: Wikipedia: Jimmy Carter
sources.description: President of the United States from 1977 to 1981

notes.text: James Earl Jimmy Carter Jr. was an American politician and humanitarian who served as the 39th president of the United States from 1977 to 1981.
A member of the Democratic Party, Jimmy Carter served as the 76th governor of Georgia from 1971 to 1975 and in the Georgia State Senate from 1963 to 1967.
Jimmy Carter lived longer than any other president in US history, reaching age 100.
Jimmy Carter is remembered as a politician connected with United States.
Jimmy Carter's recorded life dates place this profile around 1924-2024.
